_about: A model of the shortcuts in the SalesLH lakehouse. Each entry has name, location (Tables, or a folder under Files), target_type (OneLake or ADLS Gen2), target_path and auth ("caller identity" or "connection").

needs.customers: Read CRM_LH's Delta table customers as a table in SalesLH, without copying it. Staging_LH already has a shortcut to it, Tables/customers_link.
needs.partner_exports: Browse the CSV files in the partner's ADLS Gen2 container partner, folder exports.
needs.orders_2025: Read Archive_LH's Delta table orders_2025 as a table in SalesLH.
